name: Trips - Right - 38 Toss

QB.rule: Quick pitch to the tailback, then run the other way, to the left, like you still have it.

TB.rule: Run flat, outside and behind the quarterback, and catch the pitch on the run. Ahead of him is a fumble.

coaching_points: The pitch goes early. A quarterback who waits to be tackled first will pitch it on the ground.
There is no second back to lead, so the split end takes the force man. The slot screens the corner.
The tailback stays behind the split end and turns up in the alley.
